description: This file is a Java class implementing configuration handling for health check persistence in the Eclipse Ditto project. It defines the DefaultPersistenceConfig class which reads configuration values related to persistence from a given Config object and exposes methods to access these settings.

classes.name: DefaultPersistenceConfig
classes.description: An immutable class representing persistence configuration for health checks, providing access to enabled status, timeout duration, and metrics reporter configuration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method that creates an instance of DefaultPersistenceConfig from a given Config object.
